data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) failed to audit the LICENSE file due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an overall 'inconclusive' verdict. The second model (deepseek) successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: First model failed to audit LICENSE due to a transient API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable files (like LICENSE) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if all executable packaging files (PKGBUILD, .install) are safely audited.
Implement retry logic for transient LLM API errors before marking a file audit as failed.
